$comment: Synthetic tenant whose only paid licence is Microsoft 365 E7. Built because E7 broke twice: its agent service plans once disqualified it from entitling anything, and it carried no price so a tenant holding nothing else produced a report with no dollar figures at all. The service plan names are Microsoft product identifiers and are the same in every E7 tenant. Everything else here is invented.
